notes.title: Apocalypse - Zombie City Zombies vs. Vampires Fest Update
notes.notes:
Hello Survivors,

It’s been a while, but we’re excited to finally bring you an update we’ve been planning for some time. The Steam Zombies vs. Vampires Fest felt like the perfect opportunity to roll it out.

This update includes a variety of new features and improvements:

🔧 General Updates

UI Enhancements

Updated Zombie Animations

Improved Player Animations

Revamped Settings Menu

FPS Cap Selection

Updated Volume Controls

🎵 Audio

Brand-new soundtrack by Lusitanian Deviant Records – check out more of their awesome music here:
https://www.youtube.com/@lusitanian_deviant_records/videos

🔫 New Weapon System

Weapon Switching – You can now switch between melee weapons, equipment, and guns using the number keys (1–3).
Key mapping isn’t available yet, but it’s coming in a future update.

💣 New Equipment – Grenades

Frag Grenade

Scatter Grenade

Sticky Grenade

Warp Grenade

Plasma Grenade

You’ll start with a limited supply of 1,000 grenades per type for now. In future updates, you'll begin with fewer but be able to purchase more using points—similar to weapon ammo.

⚔️ New Melee Weapons

Sword

Axe

Mace

Spear

Shield

These are especially useful when you're low on ammo.

🔮 What’s Next?

There will likely be one or two more updates before we enter Early Access. These may include:

Additional weapon types

New maps

Once Early Access begins, the story mode will gradually be integrated into the game.

If all goes well, we’re also planning to explore:

Character selection

New game modes

Multiplayer support



🛠️ Got Feedback or Bugs?
If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, please share them on the Discussion Board.
We truly value your input and would love to hear your thoughts.

Thanks for taking the time to read this announcement — we hope you enjoy Steam’s Zombies vs. Vampires Fest and all the new additions!

notes.title: Apocalypse - Zombie City Update
notes.notes:
The demo for Apocalypse - Zombie City has been updated. Here is a list of all the updates.

 UI changes.
 Zombies now have different animations.
 Zombies now have increased movement speed.
 The animation for the player has been updated.
 Player movement speed has been increased.
 Sniper recoil mechanism updated
 Sniper scope updated
 Map scenery updated 
 Added Auto-Reload
 New weapons have been added as well including a Rocket Launcher, Gatling Gun, and Laser Rifle 


Stay tuned for more updates. If everything goes as planned, there will probably be one or two more updates before the game is placed into early access.

If you encounter any bugs or encounter issues with the update, please don't hesitate to share them on the discussion board. If you have any questions, thoughts, or feedback, we highly value your input and are eager to hear your thoughts.

Thank you for taking the time to read this announcement.

notes.title: Apocalypse - Zombie City Demo Update
notes.notes:
The demo for Apocalypse - Zombie City has received several updates aimed at enhancing the gameplay experience. Here is a list detailing the changes:



  A tutorial has been added to aid players in understanding the game controls, making it more accessible.

 The player movement speed has been increased for improved agility.

 The zombie movement speed has been increased to improve the pacing of the game for the player's experience.

 The interval for coin de-spawning has been extended, ensuring coins take less time to vanish from the game.

 Modifications have been implemented in the UI to enhance user experience.



If you encounter any bugs or encounter issues with the update, please don't hesitate to share them on the discussion board. If you have any questions, thoughts, or feedback, we highly value your input and are eager to hear your thoughts.

Thank you for taking the time to read this announcement.
